projectDescription: An AI-native A-share investment research workbench that lets self-directed investors build verifiable, evidence-backed research with judgment premise tracking and collaborative AI-powered workbenches.
keyFeatures: AI Super Agent for natural-language A-share research in Chinese
Dynamic research workbenches — interactive Generative UI components saved as personal dashboards
Judgment Premise tracking — record and review the premises behind your investment decisions
Evidence-backed answers — every claim linked to verifiable sources with timestamps
Portfolio analysis with historical replay, contribution, volatility, and drawdown metrics
A-share stock and ETF screening using natural language criteria
Smart notifications tied to confirmed judgment premises and watch conditions
Compliance-safe design — no buy/sell recommendations, no trade execution, no broker connection
Conversation history with reopenable original data snapshots
Company deep-dive research including financial reports, exchange announcements, and forecasts
publicApiSurface: POST /api/ask — submit a research question with context, template, and investment objects
GET /api/market/status — get current A-share market status
GET /api/market/indices — get major A-share index data
GET /api/stock/[code] — get stock details by A-share code
GET/POST /api/workbenches — list and create research workbenches
GET/POST /api/inbox — get and manage inbox items
GET /api/research — get research documents and announcements
POST /api/workbench-proposals — propose a new workbench from a conversation
POST /api/agent — interact with the research agent runtime
